The canvas engine in `engine-core.js` is from `thinking-orbs` 0.3.2 by Jakub Antalik.
Source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/main/packages/thinking-orbs
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

Only the framework-independent engine is included. Pages renders it with a Vue
component, without the package's React adapter or React dependency.
